title: Spamming
script:
-- [[ BROOKHAVEN RP - NIKHIL 5CR+ DYNAMIC ROASTER ]] --
-- UI Library: Rayfield

local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Safe Chat Sender Function
local function SendChatMessage(msg)
   if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
      local generalChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
      if generalChannel then
         generalChannel:SendAsync(msg)
      end
   else
      local defaultEvents = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
      if defaultEvents and defaultEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest") then
         defaultEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "All")
      end
   end
end

-- ================= AUTO EXECUTION CHAT NOTIFICATION =================
task.spawn(function()
   task.wait(1.2)
   local loadMsg = string.rep("@", 72) .. " NIKHIL SPAMMER LOADED 💀⚠️⚰️"
   SendChatMessage(loadMsg)
end)

-- UI Setup
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Nikhil Spammer | 5Cr+ Roaster",
   LoadingTitle = "Loading 5Cr+ Roaster...",
   LoadingSubtitle = "By Assistant",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
   KeySystem = false
})

-- Global Variables
_G.TargetName = "VIVAAN"
_G.SpamSpeed = 0.5 -- Default 0.5s delay
_G.SpammerActive = false

-- 5Cr+ Combination Component Pools (Auto Mix & Match)
local Intros = {
   "DONT RUN AWAY", "WHY ARE YOU RUNNING", "GAYE KAHA BHAAG KE", "NOOB BHAAG MAT",
   "KID DONT LEAVE", "SEARCHING FOR SKILLS IN", "AIRDROP EXPIRED FOR", "LOGOUT SPEED 100X FOR",
   "ZERO SKILL DETECTED IN", "GAME OVER FOR", "PLEASE DONT QUIT", "TRY HARDER NEXT TIME"
}

local Titles = {
   "ULTIMATE NOOB", "SPEED RUNNER", "DESERT RAT", "CLOWN PLAYER", "PRO UNINSTALLER",
   "LOBBY DWELLER", "LAG MASTER", "BOT LEGEND", "SERVER LEAVER", "KEYBOARD SMASHER"
}

local Roasts = {
   "GAVE UP SO FAST", "LOST THE GAME", "CRYING IN CORNER", "SERVER SWITCHING",
   "SKILL ISSUE CAUGHT", "FAILED THE TASK", "AFK MODE ACTIVE", "PRESS F TO PAY RESPECTS",
   "NEED MORE PRACTICE", "EXPOSED IN SERVER"
}

local Emojis = {
   "😏🤩", "💀🔥", "🤡⚡", "💥🥵", "💩👑", "⚠️👻", "🤣🤡", "🚀🔥"
}

-- Dynamic 5Cr+ Generator Engine
local function GenerateMegaRoast()
   local i = Intros[math.random(1, #Intros)]
   local t = Titles[math.random(1, #Titles)]
   local r = Roasts[math.random(1, #Roasts)]
   local e = Emojis[math.random(1, #Emojis)]
   
   return i .. " " .. t .. " " .. r .. " " .. e
end

-- ================= TAB 1: 5CR+ ROAST SPAMMER =================
local SpamTab = Window:CreateTab("Mega Roaster", 4483362458)

SpamTab:CreateInput({
   Name = "Set Target Name",
   PlaceholderText = "e.g. vivaan",
   RemoveTextOnFocusLost = false,
   Callback = function(Text)
      _G.TargetName = string.upper(Text)
      Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Target Updated", Content = "Target Tag: @" .. _G.TargetName, Duration = 2})
   end,
})

SpamTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "Spam Delay (Seconds)",
   Range = {0.1, 3.0},
   Increment = 0.1,
   CurrentValue = 0.5,
   Callback = function(Value)
      _G.SpamSpeed = Value
   end,
})

SpamTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "START 5CR+ DYNAMIC ROAST SPAM (0.5s)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      _G.SpammerActive = Value
      task.spawn(function()
         while _G.SpammerActive do
            local atSymbol = string.rep("@", 72)
            local targetTag = "@" .. _G.TargetName
            local dynamicRoast = GenerateMegaRoast()
            
            local fullMsg = atSymbol .. " " .. targetTag .. " " .. dynamicRoast
            SendChatMessage(fullMsg)
            task.wait(_G.SpamSpeed)
         end
      end)
   end,
})

-- ================= TAB 2: UTILITIES =================
local SafetyTab = Window:CreateTab("Safety", 4483362458)

SafetyTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Enable Anti-AFK",
   Callback = function()
      local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
      game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
         VirtualUser:CaptureController()
         VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
      end)
      Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Anti-AFK", Content = "Protection Enabled!", Duration = 3})
   end,
})

Rayfield:Notify({
   Title = "Nikhil Spammer Loaded!",
   Content = "5Cr+ Dynamic Roaster Ready!",
   Duration = 4,
})
